---
title: "dengue_lab"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}
library(lmtest)
library(plm)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(sandwich)
```

```{r}
df <- read_excel("df_final (1).xlsx")
```

```{r}
df <- setNames(df, c("municipio", "semagua", "dengue",
                     "incidencia","urb","pib_mil", "pop","pib_pc","saude_pormil","dens"))
```


```{r}
modelo1 = lm(log(incidencia+1) ~ semagua + urb + log(pib_pc) + saude_pormil
             , df,
             weights = pop)

summary(modelo1)
```
```{r}
vif(modelo1)
```

```{r}
coeftest(modelo1, vcov = vcovHC(modelo1, type = "HC3"))
```
```{r}
df_semfort = df %>%
  filter(municipio != "FORTALEZA")
```

```{r}
modelo2 = lm(log(incidencia+1) ~ semagua + urb + log(pib_pc) + saude_pormil
             , df_semfort,
             weights = pop)

summary(modelo2)
```
